scope: Focused fetch follow-up; fixtures on Btrfs workspace volume; five alternating pairs of three operations
script:
import json, os, re, subprocess, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
out = (Path.cwd().parent / "results").resolve()
out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
fixtures = out / "fixtures"
fixtures.mkdir()
env = dict(os.environ, GOMAXPROCS="2", CGO_ENABLED="0", TMPDIR=str(fixtures))
roots = {"baseline": Path.cwd().parent / "baseline", "candidate": Path.cwd()}
report = {"scope": "Focused fetch follow-up; fixtures on Btrfs workspace volume; five alternating pairs of three operations", "binaries": {}, "samples": []}
for name, root in roots.items():
    binary = out / (name + ".test")
    subprocess.run(["go", "test", "-c", "-o", str(binary), "./cmd/errand"], cwd=root, env=env, check=True)
    report["binaries"][name] = hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
for round_number in range(5):
    order = list(roots) if round_number % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(roots))
    for name in order:
        p = subprocess.run([str(out / (name + ".test")), "-test.v", "-test.run=^$", "-test.bench=^BenchmarkFetchCompletion$/^persistent=false$", "-test.benchtime=3x", "-test.benchmem", "-test.timeout=5m"], cwd=roots[name], env=env, text=True, capture_output=True)
        (out / f"{round_number}-{name}.txt").write_text(p.stdout + p.stderr)
        p.check_returncode()
        match = re.search(r"^BenchmarkFetchCompletion/persistent=false-\d+\s+(\d+)\s+([\d.]+) ns/op", p.stdout, re.M)
        if match is None: raise RuntimeError("Missing benchmark result")
        report["samples"].append(dict(version=name, round=round_number, iterations=int(match[1]), ns_per_op=float(match[2])))
    print(f"Completed pair {round_number + 1}/5", flush=True)
    (out / "report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
for name in roots: (out / (name + ".test")).unlink()
